unresolved.detail: httpuv 1.6.6.9000, later 1.4.2.9000 and sass 0.4.10.9000 installed descriptions do not identify their source commit/patch provenance. Version labels alone do not bind a candidate source to these compiled packages.

The historical image workflow defaults to ghcr.io/r-wasm/webr:main. WebR Dockerfile installs r-wasm/rwasm and r-lib/pak@main and uses the Posit Package Manager latest repository. No captured image digest, dependency source lock or build transaction binds all 36 packages to their complete preferred sources. The historical successful run logs endpoint returned HTTP410 on 2 November 2026.

The source tag, R 4.6.0 source/patches, 42 support-library recipe directories and Flang gitlink are collected. Exact release container/toolchain source binding is not established: deploy uses flang-wasm:main and the collected Flang Makefile clones r-wasm/llvm-project branch wasm without a commit pin. Release notes report Emscripten 4.0.8, while the gitlinked Flang Dockerfile defaults to 5.0.7. Both observed WASM binaries omit producer metadata, so the release toolchain cannot be inferred from those sections. Do not silently choose one version or claim a verified rebuild.

Downloaded archives and package recipes are groundwork. A complete source/build/install dependency closure, including WebR support libraries/toolchain, JavaScript dependencies and font components, has not been assembled and rebuilt. Matching-version R tarballs and exact-version PyPI sdists are candidates, not proof of bit-identical compiled provenance.

Archives and detailed receipts are local evidence. This portable manifest provides canonical URLs and hashes; no complete corresponding-source bundle has been published beside APK downloads. Automatic APK uploads remain paused.

next_actions: For the existing R image, obtain exact fork commits/patches plus historical container/toolchain/dependency-source provenance, or replace it with a newly built image whose complete inputs are pinned and archived. Do not equate matching version strings with that binding.

Complete and retain the full runtime/source/build-input closure, document exact rebuild/install commands, and validate the resulting runtime behavior; bit-for-bit reproducibility is a separate claim requiring comparison.

Publish durable corresponding-source downloads and the verified binary-to-source manifest beside any resumed binary uploads. Preserve existing distribution evidence and the upload gate until the delivery criterion is satisfied.
